applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations adjacent to retaining walls on southern and eastern perimeters
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on grading plan and site plan throughout the site perimeter, but specific clearance dimensions from transformer pads to retaining walls are not documented on any plan sheet.

applicableAreas: Perimeter fences on western and eastern property boundaries
findings.comment: Perimeter fencing is shown on site plan, but specific clearance dimensions from transformer pads to fences are not documented, and access door orientations for transformer pads are not indicated on the electrical plan.

Building elevations and balcony locations are not provided on the submitted plan set. Cannot verify 5-foot lateral clearance from balconies and building overhangs relative to transformer pad locations.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 windows, doors, and ventilating ducts
findings.comment: Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not documented on electrical plan. Window and door locations and elevations relative to transformer pads are not provided. Cannot verify 12-foot horizontal clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment.
Building floor plans and stairwell locations for fire exits are not provided on the submitted site plan set. Cannot verify clearances from transformer pads to stairwells.

applicableAreas: Building exterior areas serving as fire exit routes
findings.comment: Fire escape locations are not identified on the site plan. Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified. Cannot verify 20-foot radial clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment.

Access door orientations for transformer pads are not indicated on the preliminary electrical plan. Cannot verify which side is the hot-stick use area requiring 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building.
No niche or confined space configuration is identified on the site plan. Cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearances in enclosed areas are not provided.

applicableAreas: Landscape planting areas near transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows trees identified by functional type (SY, PL, P, M) but does not provide tree species identification or cross-reference with ECM Appendix F utility-compatible species. Cannot verify utility-compatibility of trees within 10 feet of pads or 15 feet of overhead distribution.

Landscape plan shows shrubs and low-lying vegetation in parking areas and street yards, but specific clearance distances from transformer access doors and other sides are not documented. Access door orientation not indicated.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 feet of transformer pads and underground electric lines
findings.comment: Landscape plan indicates trees in proximity to transformer areas but no root barrier detail sheets are provided. Landscape details sheet (Sheet 37) reference does not appear on the landscape plan blocks.

applicableAreas: Main drive loop serving emergency access
findings.comment: Drive loop is shown on site plan, but no explicit fire lane designation with striping, signage, or clearance dimensions relative to transformer pads are documented.
Water line routing is shown on utility and electrical plans but specific separation dimensions from transformer pads are not documented on the plan sheets.
Wastewater line routing is shown on utility and electrical plans but specific separation dimensions from transformer pads are not documented.

applicableAreas: Underground storm drain lines across site
findings.comment: Storm drain routing is shown on utility and electrical plans but specific separation dimensions from transformer pads are not documented.

Multiple utilities (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric) are shown crossing on site plans but specific 12-inch horizontal and vertical separation dimensions between transformer pads and other utilities are not documented.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and utility routing
findings.comment: Plan is two-dimensional and does not provide vertical relationship information (profile views or cross-sections) to verify that transformer pads and AE underground facilities are not located over/under other utilities or customer structures.
No overhead distribution lines are indicated on the electrical plan. Applicability of 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance requirement cannot be determined.
No overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors are indicated on the electrical plan. Applicability of 15-foot radius clearance requirement cannot be determined.

applicableAreas: Building structures and parking areas above or adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in areas with overhead structures (buildings, garages, covered areas). Cross-sections are required to verify vertical clearance compliance in access paths.

Transformer equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not specified on the electrical plan. Cannot verify whether drainage flow requirements apply or whether grading slopes are directed away from buildings.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to drainage, water, sewer, and electrical easements
findings.comment: Facts.md documents two critical easements (Greenbelt Access & Use Easement #2010070731 and City of Austin Drainage Easement #2011021137) covering approximately 0.44 acres in the NE portion that are NOT depicted on the submitted site plan. Applicability of transformer pad prohibition in drainage easements cannot be verified until all recorded easements are depicted.
No transformer easements are delineated on the electrical plan or site plan. Easement boundaries showing accessibility rights around transformer pads for Austin Energy are not shown.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformer pads to meters
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformer pads to meters is shown on the plan but is not explicitly documented as 100% on private property. Property line relationships to all routing points are not dimensioned.

Transformer pad dimensions (length × width) are not documented on the electrical plan. Specific pad dimensions are not shown to match Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets. No AE Design-approved detail sheets are included in the plan set.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads 4 and 5 adjacent to internal parking areas
findings.comment: Transformer pads 4 and 5 are located adjacent to parking areas and vehicle circulation routes within 4 feet. No 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal bollards are shown on the electrical plan or detail sheets. Required bollards per AE Design equipment pad details are not provided.

No overhead distribution facilities are shown on the electrical plan. Applicability of prohibition against customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs, etc.) installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution cannot be determined.
